performanceDiagnostics.scope: Raw instrumented emulator CPU/PSS and stage events; excludes fixture-process CPU/PSS. Not screenshots or device performance acceptance.

jvm.reason: JVM tests have no device UI

scope: Fixed active-task-pair diagnostic only: one selected test per API. Other suite tests were not selected and receive no passing status; this cannot replace a full regression. This fixed diagnostic plans six AC/CA alternating pairs per dedicated emulator, with five fresh tasks per arm. Across eight APIs the numeric denominator is 48 planned pairs, 96 arms and 480 trials, distinct from eight selected cases. A uses scripted accessibility actions on real Fixture controls with the Agent service off; it is not human, touch or IME timing. C uses the real Agent controller and local test model. Task CPU and elapsed time exclude setup and endpoint PSS probes. Only atomically committed trials are collected; interrupted prefixes and failed or absent results remain explicit. The resident instrumented process includes the same-process model, excludes Fixture resources, and does not establish steady-state or peak PSS, causal overhead, real-model or physical-device budgets.
